verdict.rationale: Relay's own bill pay lets users upload vendor bills, automate approvals with multi-step approval rules, and pay vendors, which covers the 'routed for payment' part of the story. Nothing shows automatic matching of invoices to purchase orders, and the expense categorization evidence concerns receipts and transactions rather than coding of bills. missing for 10: invoice-to-PO matching, automatic GL coding of bills, AI-driven bill extraction, independent or hands-on corroboration of the bill-approval workflow.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have vendor invoices automatically matched to purchase orders, coded, and routed for payment

citations.quote: Upload bills, delegate tasks, automate approvals, and pay vendors the way they want to be paid.
